from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-seq0/frozen/seen/play/users/u087/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    sep = 4
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(g) if all(v == sep for v in row)]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(g[r][c] == sep for r in range(h))]
    bg = Counter(v for row in g for v in row if v != sep).most_common(1)[0][0]
    row_bounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    regions = []
    for ri in range(len(row_bounds)-1):
        r0, r1 = row_bounds[ri]+1, row_bounds[ri+1]
        for ci in range(len(col_bounds)-1):
            c0, c1 = col_bounds[ci]+1, col_bounds[ci+1]
            cells = [(r-r0, c-c0, g[r][c]) for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1) if g[r][c] != bg]
            if cells:
                regions.append((r0, r1, c0, c1, cells))
    if not regions:
        return g
    # The populated compartment is the pattern to repeat in the other compartments.
    r0, r1, c0, c1, pattern = regions[0]
    for ri in range(len(row_bounds)-1):
        a, b = row_bounds[ri]+1, row_bounds[ri+1]
        for ci in range(len(col_bounds)-1):
            x, y = col_bounds[ci]+1, col_bounds[ci+1]
            if (a, b, x, y) == (r0, r1, c0, c1):
                continue
            if b-a != r1-r0 or y-x != c1-c0:
                continue
            for dr, dc, color in pattern:
                g[a+dr][x+dc] = color
    return g
'''
path=programs/'task-bb214fc7.py'
